snippet.title: Stuntman: Hollywood - Jurassic World Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Prepare yourself for the action packed scenes inspired by Universal Pictures' Jurassic World. Traverse your way through perilous environments, while also keeping an eye out for oncoming "obstacles". Make every take count, and as always, in style.

The best stuntmen can handle any vehicle thrown their way. Drifts and jumps are one thing, but on two wheels, you'll require an entirely different set of skills. Pull off gravity-defying flips and slide to hit your marks. The director demands noting less than perfection.
